user.title: Connect your Baby Tracker account
user.description: Sign in with the email and password you use in the Baby Tracker app. Home Assistant joins your account's sync group as its own device.

data_description.password: The password of your Baby Tracker account.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Baby Tracker again
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant can no longer sign in to {email}. Enter that account's current password.

data_description.password: The current password of your Baby Tracker account.

error.invalid_auth: The email or password is wrong.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the Baby Tracker service. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Baby Tracker account is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That is a different account than the one this entry was set up with. Add it as a new entry instead.

error.bottle_too_large: That's more than any bottle: use at most 32 fl. oz. or 1000 mL.

data_description.bottle_size: How much the Bottle button logs for each press. New installs start at 120 mL of formula in a metric unit system and 4 fl. oz. otherwise.
data_description.bottle_unit: The unit of the bottle size: fl. oz. or mL.
data_description.bottle_type: Whether the Bottle button logs formula or pumped milk.

log_diaper.name: Log diaper
log_diaper.description: Adds a diaper record for a baby, as Home Assistant's own device in the Baby Tracker account.

type.name: Type
type.description: What kind of diaper it was.

time.name: Time
time.description: When it happened. Defaults to now. A time without an offset is read in Home Assistant's time zone.

note.name: Note
note.description: An optional note to save with the diaper.

object_id.name: Record ID
object_id.description: A UUID you choose. Reuse the same one to retry safely: if a write with this ID already landed, nothing is added again. Leave it empty for a new diaper each time.

undo.name: Undo
undo.description: Deletes a record Home Assistant created. Without a record ID, it deletes the most recent one, and running it again deletes the next older one. Records made by the phones can't be deleted here.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The Baby Tracker account to undo in. Use this or a baby.

device_id.name: Baby
device_id.description: A baby's device. With no record ID, only that baby's most recent record is deleted. Use this or an account.

object_id.name: Record ID
object_id.description: The ID of the record to delete. Defaults to the most recent record Home Assistant created.

log_bottle.name: Log bottle
log_bottle.description: Adds a formula or pumped-milk bottle for a baby, as Home Assistant's own device in the Baby Tracker account.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: How much the baby had. Must be more than zero.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: The unit of the amount. Defaults to fl. oz.

time.name: Time
time.description: When the bottle was given. Defaults to now. A time without an offset is read in Home Assistant's time zone.

note.name: Note
note.description: An optional note to save with the record.

object_id.name: Record ID
object_id.description: A UUID you choose. Reuse the same one to retry safely: if a write with this ID already landed, nothing is added again. Leave it empty for a new record each time.

log_nursing.name: Log nursing
log_nursing.description: Adds a finished nursing session for a baby. Give the minutes on one side or both.

left_minutes.name: Left side (minutes)
left_minutes.description: Whole minutes on the left side.

right_minutes.name: Right side (minutes)
right_minutes.description: Whole minutes on the right side.

finish_side.name: Finished on
finish_side.description: The side the session ended on. Defaults to the last side used, or right when both were.

end_time.name: End time
end_time.description: When the session ended. Defaults to now. It starts that many minutes earlier, the total of both sides. A time without an offset is read in Home Assistant's time zone.

note.name: Note
note.description: An optional note to save with the record.

object_id.name: Record ID
object_id.description: A UUID you choose. Reuse the same one to retry safely: if a write with this ID already landed, nothing is added again. Leave it empty for a new record each time.

log_sleep.name: Log sleep
log_sleep.description: Adds a finished sleep for a baby. The length is rounded to whole minutes.

start.name: Start
start.description: When the sleep began. A time without an offset is read in Home Assistant's time zone.

end.name: End
end.description: When the sleep ended. It must be after the start.

note.name: Note
note.description: An optional note to save with the record.

object_id.name: Record ID
object_id.description: A UUID you choose. Reuse the same one to retry safely: if a write with this ID already landed, nothing is added again. Leave it empty for a new record each time.

log_pump.name: Log pump
log_pump.description: Adds a pumping session to a Baby Tracker account. A pump belongs to the account, not a baby. Give the total amount, or the amount for one side or both (then the total is their sum).

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The Baby Tracker account to log the pump to.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: The total pumped, for a pump that wasn't split by side. Use this or the side amounts, not both.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long the session lasted, with both sides together. Use this or the minutes for each side, not both.

left_amount.name: Left amount
left_amount.description: How much came from the left side. Use this and the right side instead of the total.

right_amount.name: Right amount
right_amount.description: How much came from the right side. Use this and the left side instead of the total.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: The unit of the amounts. Defaults to fl. oz.

left_minutes.name: Left side (minutes)
left_minutes.description: Whole minutes on the left side.

right_minutes.name: Right side (minutes)
right_minutes.description: Whole minutes on the right side.

finish_side.name: Finished on
finish_side.description: The side the session ended on. Defaults to the last side used, or right when both were.

time.name: Start time
time.description: When the session began. Defaults to now. A time without an offset is read in Home Assistant's time zone.

note.name: Note
note.description: An optional note to save with the record.

object_id.name: Record ID
object_id.description: A UUID you choose. Reuse the same one to retry safely: if a write with this ID already landed, nothing is added again. Leave it empty for a new record each time.

start_sleep.name: Start sleep
start_sleep.description: Starts a sleep timer for a baby. It syncs at once, so the phones show the sleep running.

start.name: Start
start.description: When the sleep began. Defaults to now. It can't be in the future or more than 24 hours ago. A time without an offset is read in Home Assistant's time zone.

note.name: Note
note.description: An optional note to save with the sleep.

object_id.name: Record ID
object_id.description: A UUID you choose. Reuse the same one to retry safely: if a sleep with this ID already started, nothing is added again.

stop_sleep.name: Stop sleep
stop_sleep.description: Ends the baby's running sleep, whether it started in Home Assistant or on a phone.

end.name: End
end.description: When the sleep ended. Defaults to now. A sleep longer than 24 hours is saved as 24 hours.

start_nursing.name: Start nursing
start_nursing.description: Starts Home Assistant's nursing timer on a side, or switches to that side if the timer is on the other one. Nothing is saved until the timer stops.

switch_nursing_side.name: Switch nursing side
switch_nursing_side.description: Moves the running nursing timer to the other side, keeping the time on the first.

stop_nursing.name: Stop nursing
stop_nursing.description: Stops the nursing timer and saves one nursing record with each side's minutes, the side it ended on, and the start time.

note.name: Note
note.description: An optional note to save with the nursing record.

discard_nursing.name: Discard nursing
discard_nursing.description: Throws away a nursing timer that is running in Home Assistant, without saving anything. Use it for a timer that was started or left running by mistake.

start_pump.name: Start pump
start_pump.description: Starts Home Assistant's pump timer for a Baby Tracker account. Nothing is saved until the timer stops. Starting while it runs is an error.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The Baby Tracker account whose pump timer to start.

stop_pump.name: Stop pump
stop_pump.description: Stops Home Assistant's pump timer and saves one pumping session. The minutes are the time since the start, rounded to whole minutes. Give the amount to save the total with it; without one, the session is saved with an amount of 0 (no volume).

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The Baby Tracker account whose pump timer to stop.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: The total pumped. Leave it out to save the session with no volume.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: The unit of the amount. Defaults to fl. oz.

note.name: Note
note.description: An optional note to save with the pump.

own_log_gap.title: Baby Tracker can't write for {account}
own_log_gap.description:
For more than an hour, every attempt to write to {account} has failed. The service says Home Assistant's own log for this account is longer than what Home Assistant can read back, so writing is paused to avoid skipping or overwriting entries.

To fix it:

1. Go to Settings, then Devices & services, and open Baby Tracker (Nighp).
2. Open the menu next to {account} and choose Delete, then confirm.
3. Add Baby Tracker (Nighp) again with the same email and password.

Adding it again reloads the account's history, and Home Assistant appears as a new device in the Baby Tracker app. The old Home Assistant device stays in the app's device list.

nursing_timer_long.title: The nursing timer for {baby} has run for over an hour
nursing_timer_long.description:
Home Assistant's nursing timer for {baby} has been running for more than an hour. The Baby Tracker app doesn't show a running nursing timer, so nothing else will end it, and Home Assistant has stopped syncing every minute because of it.

To fix it, either:

1. Stop the timer (turn off the Nursing switch that is on, or call the Stop nursing action) to save one nursing record. A side is saved as at most 240 minutes.
2. Discard the timer with the Discard nursing button or action to throw it away without saving anything.

This notice goes away when the timer stops or is discarded.

deprecated_action_field.title: An automation uses an old field of {action}
deprecated_action_field.description:
Something called the Baby Tracker action {action} with the field {field}, which is deprecated and will stop working in a later release. To fix it:

1. Find the automation, script, or dashboard button that calls {action}.
2. Replace {field} with {replacement}, and pick the same baby or account.
3. Save it, then run it again.

This notice goes away on its own after the next restart, unless something still uses the old field.

pump_timer_long.title: The pump timer has run for over an hour
pump_timer_long.description:
Home Assistant's pump timer has been running for more than an hour. The Baby Tracker app doesn't show a running pump, so nothing else will end it, and Home Assistant has stopped syncing every minute because of it.

To fix it, turn off the Pump timer switch, or call the Stop pump action, to save the session. A session is saved as at most 240 minutes. If the session wasn't real, use the Undo action to delete the record Home Assistant just saved.

This notice goes away when the timer stops.
